items.title: TRENDnet TEW-751DR UPnP Event gena.php GENA notify init os command injection
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in TRENDnet TEW-751DR 1.03B01. Affected by this vulnerability is the function gena.php::GENA notify init of the file htdocs/upnpinc/gena.php of the component UPnP Event Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument uri results in os command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

items.title: WordPress Buddyboss Platform plugin <= 3.5.0 - Privilege Escalation vulnerability
items.summary: Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in BuddyBoss Buddyboss Platform buddyboss-platform allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects Buddyboss Platform: from n/a through 3.5.0.

items.title: Containers/image: digest type does not guarantee valid type
items.summary: A flaw was found in the github.com/containers/image library. This flaw allows attackers to trigger unexpected authenticated registry accesses on behalf of a victim user, causing resource exhaustion, local path traversal, and other attacks.

items.title: Themify Base <= 1.2.4 - Subscriber+ Privilege Escalation
items.summary: Themify Base WordPress theme through 1.2.4 does not perform capability checks on its option save and read AJAX actions, which are protected only by a generic nonce that other commonly expose on the front end, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to update arbitrary blog options such as the default role and open registration, and gain administrator access when such a is active.

items.title: Popup Builder <= 4.4.6 - Admin+ SSRF via sgpb-background-image
items.summary: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not validate a user-supplied URL before requesting it server-side and storing the fetched response so that it can be read back, allowing users with Administrator privileges to perform Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks and read the responses of internal services.

items.title: Popup Builder <= 4.4.6 - Authenticated Private and Draft Post Content Disclosure via Popup Preview
items.summary: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not properly check authorization before allowing a user to store popup preview data against arbitrary posts, nor restrict who can read that content back on public requests, allowing users granted access to the Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 to disclose the private and draft content of posts they do not own to unauthenticated visitors.

items.title: Popup Builder <= 4.4.6 - Unauthenticated Draft and Private Popup Content Disclosure via 'sg popup id' Parameter
items.summary: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not check the publish status or the visitor's capabilities before rendering a popup requested by its ID in the URL, allowing unauthenticated users to read the content and configuration of popups that are still drafts or are marked private.

items.title: Popup Builder <= 4.4.6 - Authenticated Stored XSS via Custom CSS Field
items.summary: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not sanitise or escape a custom styling value before storing it and printing it back into the pages a popup loads on, allowing users who are allowed to manage popups (an ability that can be delegated to lower-privileged roles) to inject JavaScript that executes in the browser of every visitor, including logged-in administrators.

items.title: Popup Builder <= 4.4.6 - Contributor+ Stored XSS via Shortcode Event Attribute
items.summary: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not properly sanitize and escape a popup shortcode attribute before it is reflected into a page and evaluated client-side, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to inject arbitrary JavaScript that executes in the session of any higher-privileged user, such as an administrator, who views the affected content.

items.title: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) | Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') (CWE-89)
items.summary: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability that could result in a Security feature bypass. A low-privileged attacker could leverage this vulnerability to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized read and limited write access. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

items.title: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) | Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') (CWE-94)
items.summary: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by an Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. A low-privileged attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

items.title: Apache Airflow Reflected Cross-site Scripting vulnerability in 404 Endpoint
items.summary: It was noticed an XSS in certain 404 pages that could be exploited to perform an XSS attack. Chrome will detect this as a reflected XSS attempt and prevent the page from loading.
